description: Harcourt Butler Technical University (formerly Harcourt Butler Technological Institute) is a residential technical university in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, established as a university by the Government of Uttar Pradesh in 2016. Its official site describes East and West campuses in Kanpur and programmes in engineering, technology, sciences, management, humanities and other professional fields.

agent_notes: Normal TLS verification first produced the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to confirmed expected search and official HBTU hostnames.

The official identity is clear: the address page gives Harcourt Butler Technical University, Nawabganj, Kanpur (U.P.) 208 002; the about page identifies HBTU Kanpur and its East and West campuses in Kanpur.

The academic catalogue is extensive but not internally complete or consistent. The general programmes page lists the main B.Tech, B.Tech lateral-entry, working-professional, BBA, B.Pharm, M.Tech, MCA, MBA, M.Sc and doctoral families; the 2026-27 admission page additionally establishes current B.Tech Biotechnology, B.Pharm, B.Tech Biotechnology lateral entry, B.Pharm lateral entry and BS-MS activity.

The Biotechnology department page separately lists M.Sc. Biotechnology, M.Sc. Biochemistry, M.Sc. Forensic Bioanalytics and Ph.D Biotechnology. The general catalogue and current admission pages do not present these programmes consistently, so course_catalogue_status is partial_official_website and manual review is required.

The official incubation page exposes Personality Development Courses, Startup courses and Deep-Tech courses, but gives no linked catalogue/detail for Deep-Tech courses. The two linked course pages explicitly label Certified Personality Development Programme and Certified Start-Up Course; the 2023 SWAYAM Yoga PDF and expired admission/event notices were not treated as HBTU certificate programmes.

Duration and eligibility were left null unless explicitly stated on an official catalogue page. Ph.D. eligibility is copied from the official Ph.D. table; some rows use shared row-spanned eligibility cells.

The local career tree was queried read-only from assets/data/career_path.db. Direct discipline mappings were preferred; generic or absent disciplines use nearest-parent/closest-specialization mappings. The tree node for slug bpharm is labelled Medical Updated, so that mapping is flagged as a career-tree label issue.
